Name: Cuter Fatter Cow Photos
Author: Lavendarjosh
Description:
That's what it does, for consistency.
The cow sprites are from Identitypollution's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/348?tab=description]Cuter Fatter Cows mod [/url]and Haley's sprites in the photos are from Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437?tab=description]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites mod[/url], but none of those are technically required.

There's a version for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]Content Patcher [/url]and an optional replacer version if you prefer that instead.
